fields.description: Stored as Text Editor (not HTML) -- Frappe's "HTML" fieldtype is a no_value_field with no DB column (see frappe.model.no_value_fields); it can only render static markup from the DocType itself, never store or return per-row data. Text Editor is the standard Frappe fieldtype for a DB-persisted, Desk-editable rich-HTML field, which is what get_consent actually needs to read back per language.
fields.label: Consent
